 Match Preview
 FA Cup - Game Week 1 Nov 6, 2026 - 13:45 The RAW Charging Stadium Oxford City host Leicester City at The RAW Charging Stadium in Marston in what is a rare FA Cup meeting between sides from vastly different levels of English football.
 Oxford City, competing in the National League North/South, face a stiff test against a Leicester City side currently playing in League One under Russell Martin. The FA Cup's capacity to produce these cross-division fixtures is part of what makes the competition so enduring.
 Ross Jenkins's Oxford City side come into this match on the back of a 1-3 defeat to South Shields in the National League, though they showed resilience earlier in the cup run by beating Torquay United in qualification. Their home crowd will be vital if they are to cause an upset.
 Leicester arrive in decent shape. Martin's side drew 2-2 with Stevenage in their most recent league outing but have won three of their last five across all competitions, including a commanding 3-0 victory over Wigan Athletic.
 For Oxford City, this is the kind of occasion their season can be defined by. For Leicester, it is a chance to progress in a cup that still carries weight regardless of which division a club occupies.
